description: List firewall rules from the filter, nat or raw table on a MikroTik router, IPv4 (family ip, the default) or IPv6 (family ipv6), in evaluation order. Supports filtering by chain and disabled state, with pagination.

chain.description: Filter rules by chain name (e.g. forward, input, srcnat, prerouting)

disabled.description: Filter by disabled state: true, false, or all

family.description: Address family: ip (IPv4, /ip firewall) or ipv6 (/ipv6 firewall)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

table.description: Firewall table to query: filter, nat or raw

name: list_firewall_rules
title: List Firewall Rules
